name: museum_flat
title: 博物馆平光
what: The Palace Museum's set-up for low-contrast object photographs (Jin Yueping 2020, printed p.554, Fig. 2: two flashes in 60 x 60 cm softboxes, front left and front right at 45 degrees, grey paper behind), plus an optional top light (Meng Chengguang's guidance: top, key, fill and background lights, printed pp.581-582). For material cards against museum catalogue photographs. Found in research (ref/studio/report.md).

look_target.note: a reference film: a look target for the light only, never material truth

shots.what: paper stack on cream: even, frontal-soft, no hard shadow, seamless background
blue-and-white plate on red: even light, a broad soft sheen, flat background
plant section on cream: flat, shadowless

spectrum.why: v0: every lamp of a rig has the same spectrum, the key light rgbscene projects with, so one bounce is exact (docs/optics.md); 5500 K blackbody: a stand-in for daylight-balanced studio flash or LED, our choice

lamps.name: left
lamps.why: jin2020: a 60 x 60 cm softbox at 45 degrees front-left; its height (30 degrees) and distance (1 m) are not given there: our choice; equal to the other side, as the set-up is for even, low-contrast light

lamps.name: right
lamps.why: jin2020: a 60 x 60 cm softbox at 45 degrees front-right; its height (30 degrees) and distance (1 m) are not given there: our choice; equal to the other side, as the set-up is for even, low-contrast light

lamps.name: top
lamps.why: meng: a top light; its size (5 R), height and strength (a stop under the sides) are our choice

backdrop.why: the default ground; a recipe sets the colour for its object (backdrop.material)

sources.jin2020: Jin Yueping, Capturing surface texture ... (Palace Museum), https://www.dpm.org.cn/Uploads/File/2020/11/13/u5fae29884d938.pdf, printed p.554, section 1(1)2, Fig. 2 [reported practice]
sources.meng: Meng Chengguang, 博物馆之文物摄影, https://img.dpm.org.cn/Uploads/File/2020/11/13/u5fae2a6a1aea0.pdf, printed pp.581-582 [guidance]
sources.british_museum: two 60 x 90 cm softboxes on Colorama Storm Grey (image record Oc1944,02.2109) [reported practice]
